notes.subject: יכסומו
notes.rationale: ketiv יכסומו vs qere יכסמו; both yield a jussive 'let it cover them', the ketiv's full spelling kept.

notes.subject: מְסִבָּי
notes.rationale: hiphil participle of סבב, 'those who sit/encompass around me'; 'surround' carries the circle, 'sit at table' the divan sense at Song 1:12.

notes.subject: עֲמַל שְׂפָתֵימוֹ
notes.rationale: their own malicious speech becomes the 'trouble' that covers them — the instrument turns on its user.

translation: As for the head of those who surround me, may the trouble of their lips cover them.
